title: Reconcile final closure and re-freeze Bead authority with ADR 0020
description:
Authority/specification reconciliation only. Reconcile the future final closure and re-freeze chain with accepted ADR 0020 and the integrated transition design at docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md before any implementation agent enters the eshyra-o9bd.19.6.* closure sequence. This task must not implement the closure program.

AUTHORITY AND SCOPE

Audit at minimum these live Beads in their own descriptions and acceptance criteria:
- eshyra-o9bd.19.6
- eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1
- eshyra-o9bd.19.6.2
- eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3
- eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4
- eshyra-o9bd.16
- eshyra-o9bd.14
- eshyra-2zyy

Also identify any additional live downstream Bead whose acceptance criteria materially depend on the superseded pre-ADR-0020 closure model. For every affected Bead, classify each relevant requirement as retained, narrowed, replaced, retired as superseded, or still valid but requiring rewording to avoid a global-completeness interpretation. Preserve valid historical context where it remains useful, but reconcile the operative description and acceptance criteria in the owning Bead itself. Every future Bead must be independently executable from its own text without requiring an agent to know that contradictory prose elsewhere is obsolete.

REQUIRED AUTHORITY

Apply ADR 0020, including its rule-awareness infrastructure boundary, DM-default interpretation and adjudication boundary, bounded positive deterministic capabilities, many-to-many relationships, and prohibition on treating absence, unbound, unclassified, or not-recognized material as evidence of safety, completeness, or absent mechanics. Apply the integrated transition design, especially its nine-condition re-freeze truthfulness model. Do not introduce any review-contract, checkpoint, or review-artifact ceremony.

PRESERVE REAL OBLIGATIONS

Retain concrete, testable obligations that ADR 0020 did not remove, where applicable: source fidelity; truthful provenance; deterministic reproducibility; truthful in-band scope of audit/readiness artifacts; durable disposition of known findings; correctness and fail-closed behavior of positively selected deterministic capabilities; no known source invention; ownership and regression coverage for live runtime safety contracts; explicit unresolved discovery/adjudication limits; independent candidate-bundle audit and re-freeze sequencing; and freeze-manifest/thaw-note policy. Do not weaken legitimate source-fidelity, regression, independent-review, or fail-closed requirements into vague truthfulness prose.

EXPLICITLY RETIRE OR REJECT REVIVAL

The reconciled Beads must explicitly reject or remove as operative prerequisites:
- global deterministic closure;
- universal retrieval/discovery completeness;
- zero engine-pending clauses as a re-freeze prerequisite;
- universal clause identity or ontology;
- one-record/one-clause/one-capability completeness models;
- treating a registry, schema, scenario corpus, readiness artifact, or hook inventory as proof of full support;
- any other corpus-wide negative claim not restored by newer accepted authority.

The nine-condition model must replace the withdrawn zero-engine-pending/global-negative model, while bounded capability correctness and fail-closed behavior remain real obligations.

DELIVERABLE AND BOUNDARY

Update only Bead authority/specification text and the one required dependency edge. Record permanent evidence in the affected owning Beads or their durable notes showing the audit, each classification, the exact superseded wording/disposition, and the resulting authority. This is a material authority/process correction: it changes the specification future implementation agents execute, but is not DESIGN_INVALIDATED because ADR 0020 is the accepted replacing authority. Do not perform implementation, pack regeneration, importer changes, capability implementation, finding closure, or re-freeze work.

The intended sequence remains:
this reconciliation -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.2 -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 -> eshyra-o9bd.16 -> eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4 -> eshyra-o9bd.14 -> eshyra-2zyy.
Do not add blockers for W8, W9, W10, W11, W15, or the current eshyra-jhpt execution path, and do not duplicate transitive edges merely for visibility.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Permanent evidence shows every live closure/re-freeze Bead in scope was reviewed against ADR 0020 and docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md, including any additional materially affected live downstream Bead.
2. For each affected Bead, relevant requirements are classified as retained, narrowed, replaced, retired as superseded, or valid but reworded, and contradictory pre-ADR-0020 requirements are removed, narrowed, or marked superseded in the owning Bead itself.
3. Every future Bead in scope is independently executable from its own description and acceptance criteria, without relying on a side document to override contradictory operative prose.
4. The resulting dependency graph preserves the intended final sequence: this reconciliation, then eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1, .19.6.2, .19.6.3, eshyra-o9bd.16, .19.6.4, .14, and eshyra-2zyy.
5. eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 is blocked by this reconciliation and cannot start before it closes.
6. No affected Bead requires global deterministic closure, universal discovery completeness, zero engine-pending clauses, universal clause identity/ontology, one-record/one-clause/one-capability completeness, or another corpus-wide negative claim unless newer accepted authority explicitly restores it.
7. Retained obligations remain concrete and testable, including applicable source fidelity, provenance, reproducibility, artifact scope, finding dispositions, bounded capability correctness, fail-closed behavior, source-invention prohibition, runtime safety ownership/regression coverage, unresolved limits, independent audit sequencing, and freeze/thaw policy.
8. No new review-contract, checkpoint, or review-artifact ceremony is introduced.
9. No implementation, pack regeneration, importer change, capability implementation, finding closure, or re-freeze occurs as part of this task.
10. Record the material-change classification as an authority/specification process correction, not DESIGN_INVALIDATED.
